claims.source_quote: Pending regulatory feedback, Spyre plans to advance SPY001 into a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, Phase 2 platform trial with a master protocol in patients with moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. The platform trial is designed to efficiently evaluate each of Spyre s monotherapy and combination therapies against a common placebo control. The trial is also intended to evaluate the contribution of each monotherapy component to the safety and efficacy of Spyre s combination therapies. This Phase 2 ulcerative colitis trial is expected to initiate in mid-2025 with SPY001 and placebo arms, with SPY002, SPY003, and combination arms to be added following clinical data, nonclinical data, and regulatory feedback.
